experiment_layer: single-database exploratory replication on a second benchmark
core_hypothesis: A local Qwen model can build a schema-grounded business-semantic graph from Spider schema names, column types, keys, and the one declared FK in bike_1; graph-aware table ranking may improve table recall over raw-schema BM25 on the same 104 training questions.
selection_rule: Select a Spider train database with at most two declared FK column pairs, at least four tables, and at least 50 train questions; prioritize fewer FK pairs, then more train questions. This selects bike_1 (4 tables, 1 FK pair, 104 questions).

notes: Spider tables.json has no business column descriptions; semantic interpretations from identifiers remain uncertain.
The model must preserve the declared FK separately from any inferred candidate join.

evaluation.candidate_universe: all 4 physical tables in Spider bike_1
methods: schema_bm25: table/column names, types, primary keys, and declared FK text
flat_graph_bm25: generated graph node text flattened by physical table
typed_graph: same graph text plus fixed 0.25 one-hop neighbor contribution
evaluation.sql_parse_failure_policy: report all selected tasks and SQL parse failures; exclude parse failures/no-table cases from retrieval metrics and report exact counts

budget_and_stopping.success_signal: valid graph JSON, schema-valid table/column bindings and evidence IDs, at least one model-proposed join observed in reference SQL, and typed-graph Recall@3 above raw-schema BM25.
budget_and_stopping.stop_condition: Run one local generation, a five-question CPU smoke evaluation, then one frozen full evaluation over 104 train questions. No retry, prompt tuning, extra models, or dev/test inspection. Stop if graph output is invalid or resource checks fail.
budget_and_stopping.evidence_scope: Exploratory single database; Spider train SQL usage is a proxy label, not a unique business-semantic gold label.
